notes: People who have left no longer clutter the pickers. Choosing an approver, assigning a task, picking a reporting manager or filtering a report used to offer everyone who had ever held an account — so a colleague who left last month sat in the list looking exactly like the person who replaced them, and picking one quietly pointed the work at an account nobody can sign into. Anyone whose login has been closed, or whose last working day has already passed, is now left out of all of those lists. Only the field you have ALREADY saved keeps showing a departed name, so an old assignment never reads as empty and never gets cleared by accident. The employee master export in the web portal still includes everyone, because that is a record rather than a list to choose from. The org chart follows the same rule: people who have left are no longer drawn on it, and anyone who reported to one of them now appears under the nearest manager still with the company instead of jumping to the top of the chart — nobody is lost from the chart, they just move up. For HR Managers, the Directory now shows every employee in your company rather than only the ones assigned to you, and you can set or change an employee's HR partner and reporting manager yourself — that no longer needs a Super Admin. The company wall is unchanged: another company's staff stay invisible. So is the rule that nobody acts on their own record, and the Backend and audit accounts remain hidden. Late coming: how many late arrivals are free each month is now a setting a Super Admin controls from the web portal (Attendance settings) instead of a fixed five, and the free allowance is no longer reduced for somebody who joined part-way through the month — everyone gets the whole allowance every month, including their first. Payslips already generated keep the figures they were computed with.
